intent: Let the owner give an approved commit a release name.

edit.summary:
I made three proposals in the `authoring` domain for change request 16. The tool accepted each with 0 issues. They are proposals only, so a person still has to confirm them and nothing is deployed yet. I didn't touch `delivery`.

- **`objects.Commit`:** I added an optional `release_name` string field. Everything else on the object is unchanged.
- **`actions.name_release`:** This is a new action that the owner can take on a Commit. It takes a `name` and sets `release_name` to it. It has a precondition, `approved-to-name`, so only an approved commit can be named. I didn't make it person-only, because the request didn't ask for that.
- **`transitions.Commit`:** I added a `name_release` cell (recorded → recorded) to the existing matrix and kept all the other cells as they were.

The request doesn't say whether a release name can be changed once it's set. I didn't add a rule either way, so an owner can rename an approved commit.
